tournament.name: City Class Games Showdown VIII | Ciclo 2 Ano 3

decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing Eldrazi creatures to ramp up quickly and control the game with various spells and abilities. The key strategy involves generating mana quickly with Utopia Sprawl and the Eldrazi Temple to play powerful creatures like Emrakul and World Breaker, while also using control spells like Kozilek's Return and Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats and versatile control options while maintaining a solid mana base for consistency.

The deck focuses on using creatures with disruptive abilities to slow down the opponent's game plan while pushing damage through with aggressive creatures. By combining removal spells like Fatal Push with creatures like Flickerwisp and Skyclave Apparition, the deck can control the board while steadily applying pressure. Aether Vial helps cheat creatures into play at instant speed, allowing for surprise blocks or additional disruption. This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's resources and game plan while chipping away at their life total with evasive threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It aims to control the battlefield with cards like Static Prison and Arena of Glory, while also using cards like Goblin Bombardment for direct damage. The creatures in the deck, such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, provide additional damage potential and card advantage. The inclusion of Ajani, Nacatl Pariah adds a powerful planeswalker that can help close out the game. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly through a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells.

The deck revolves around utilizing Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to loop through your graveyard, generating infinite combos with artifacts like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal. Malevolent Rumble serves as a win condition, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Emry, Lurker of the Loch help dig for pieces of the combo. The goal is to quickly assemble your combo pieces and overwhelm your opponent with a sudden burst of damage or mill them out entirely. Strategic decision-making and resource management are crucial to the success of this deck.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of targeted discard spells, counterspells, and removal. By efficiently removing threats, countering key spells, and disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Sink into Stupor, the deck aims to control the game until it can deploy powerful threats like Murktide Regent or close out the game with evasive creatures like Abhorrent Oculus. The deck also leverages graveyard synergy with cards like Unearth and Thought Scour to gain advantage and outvalue the opponent.

This deck focuses on using ramp cards to quickly get to high mana cards like Emrakul, the Promised End and Karn, the Great Creator. It also utilizes control elements such as Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt opponents' strategies. The Eldrazi creatures and spells in this deck can be difficult to deal with for many opponents, allowing the player to take control of the game and dominate with powerful threats. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its big creatures and versatile spells while maintaining control of the game through disruption and mana acceleration.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature plays, with a mix of powerful creatures including Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco. The deck also includes powerful removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending to control the board. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding provide additional support for the aggressive creatures, and Stubborn Denial helps protect them. The land base is built to support the deck's color requirements, providing a mix of mana fixing and utility lands like Arena of Glory and Xander's Lounge.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures like Ocelot Pride and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, supported by burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. The deck also utilizes static effects like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Static Prison to control the board and push through damage. With a mix of powerful creatures and spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently. Additionally, Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls provide strong creature support and resilience. The deck is designed to swiftly close out games through a combination of direct damage and creature combat.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The key strategy involves playing powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while also using spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm to control the board and finish off the opponent. The inclusion of static prison helps to slow down the opponent's game plan, allowing the deck to maintain pressure and close out games quickly. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive nature of the deck, allowing for consistent plays and efficient mana usage.

The deck focuses on utilizing Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to set up a combo with Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Malevolent Rumble to potentially win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes cards like Mox Amber and Mishra's Bauble to generate mana and draw cards, while also utilizing Urza's Saga to search for key combo pieces. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive cards like Unholy Heat to control the board and prevent the opponent from interfering with the combo.

The deck revolves around utilizing the Underworld Breach card in combination with artifacts and graveyard recursion to create a powerful combo that can win the game quickly. By filling the graveyard with artifacts and using cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch to bring them back into play, the deck can generate a lot of mana and card advantage. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student also helps with card draw and filtering, while Basim Ibn Ishaq provides additional graveyard recursion. The deck aims to set up a strong board state and win through a powerful combo finish.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with useful abilities to create powerful combos and outvalue the opponent. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Green Sun's Zenith, the deck can search for specific creatures to fit the situation. The inclusion of Yawgmoth, Thran Physician acts as a versatile engine that can generate card advantage and control the board. Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Grist, the Hunger Tide serve as finishers to close out the game once the deck has established a dominant board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats from the board, and disrupting their hand with discard spells. The deck utilizes a mix of counter spells, removal spells, and card draw to outlast the opponent and ultimately win the game with powerful finishers like Murktide Regent and Harbinger of the Seas. The mana base is designed to provide consistent access to both blue and black mana sources, allowing for flexibility in casting spells and activating abilities.

The deck focuses on using ramp spells like Utopia Sprawl and Talismans to quickly bring out powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul and World Breaker. The control aspect comes from cards like Malevolent Rumble and Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Using Sowing Mycospawn to generate tokens and Devourer of Destiny to control the board, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats. The mana base is designed to support the ramp strategy and ensure consistency in casting high-cost spells.

This deck focuses on putting pressure on opponents quickly by playing aggressive creatures and burn spells. It aims to control the board with cards like Static Prison and wipe out threats with Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. The deck can also generate card advantage with Seasoned Pyromancer and Guide of Souls. Additionally, it has a strong mana base with fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent casting of spells. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional threats and versatility in combat.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ocelot Pride and Guide of Souls, while also utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Static Prison and Galvanic Discharge, while also providing reach with cards like Goblin Bombardment. The inclusion of cards like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Seasoned Pyromancer allows for card advantage and resilience. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around mounting early pressure and maintaining board control to secure victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a combination of efficient creatures and burn spells. The deck includes powerful aggressive creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ocelot Pride, along with burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to finish off opponents. The inclusion of cards like Static Prison and Arena of Glory helps control the battlefield and protect your creatures. Overall, the goal of this deck is to beat down opponents quickly before they have a chance to stabilize.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Guide of Souls generate tokens to help maintain board presence, while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide powerful finishers. Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge offer additional reach and removal, while Static Prison and Witch Enchanter disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes some land destruction with surgical extraction and efficient mana fixing with Arid Mesa and Flooded Strand. Overall, this deck aims to win quickly through a combination of creatures and burn spells.

The deck revolves around using Underworld Breach to continuously play spells from the graveyard, generating mana and card advantage through Mishra's Bauble, Mox Opal, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch. Grinding Station is used to mill the opponent's library, while cards like Thassa's Oracle, Aether Spellbomb, and Malevolent Rumble are key win conditions. The deck also includes disruption and removal spells like Unholy Heat and Sink into Stupor to control the game. Urza's Saga helps to find crucial artifacts while ramping up the deck's power.

This combo deck focuses on using Underworld Breach to continuously put cards from the graveyard back into the library and generate infinite mana. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble help with card advantage and fueling the combo. The goal is to mill through the deck with Grinding Station and win with Thassa's Oracle or Aether Spellbomb. The deck also utilizes artifacts like Mox Opal and Urza's Saga to ramp and generate mana quickly. The land base helps to fix colors and provide additional utility for the combo strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Underworld Breach to create a powerful combo that allows the player to continuously loop through their graveyard, drawing and playing cards from it to eventually win the game through Thassa's Oracle or Grinding Station. The deck includes a variety of artifacts and spells to fuel the combo and protect key pieces, while also providing some interaction and disruption to opponents. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on using Cascade mechanics to overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells and creatures. By chaining together spells with Cascade, the player can quickly build a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent. The deck includes a mix of disruptive spells and efficient threats to disrupt the opponent's game plan while advancing its own. With a combination of aggressive creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and efficient removal like Dead / Gone, the deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with blink effects to continuously generate value and overwhelm opponents. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Aether Vial, creatures can be temporarily removed from the battlefield then brought back for additional triggers or evasion. This strategy allows for efficient removal and disruption, while also providing a steady stream of threats to pressure the opponent. The deck also includes a mix of disruptive creatures and powerful finishers to help secure victories in the mid to late game.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures that have enter the battlefield abilities to generate value and tempo advantage, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Fatal Push and Tidehollow Sculler. Aether Vial and Ephemerate allow for blinking creatures multiple times in a turn to trigger their abilities again. The deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent quickly through aggressive creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Witch Enchanter, while also having access to removal and protection with cards like Solitude and Skyclave Apparition.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the game by disrupting opponent's plays with counterspells and removal, while also having card advantage with cards like Thought Scour and Unearth. The deck is focused on efficiently managing resources and out-valuing the opponent. It also has a strong graveyard synergy with cards like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog, which can put pressure on the opponent while generating card advantage. Additionally, the deck has a strong control element with cards like Abhorrent Oculus and Dreams of Steel and Oil to maintain board presence and win the game.

The main idea of this Dimir Control deck is to utilize a combination of creature removal, counterspells, and graveyard manipulation to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategies. By using cards like Fatal Push, Counterspell, and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to maintain board control and limit the opponent's options. Additionally, cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Unearth allow for recursion of key creatures and disruption of the opponent's graveyard. Overall, the deck seeks to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through efficient removal and disruption tactics.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan, controlling the board through counterspells and removal spells while using card draw and filtering effects to maintain card advantage. It also utilizes graveyard recursion to bring back key cards for continuous pressure. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game, slowly grinding the opponent down while setting up for a powerful late-game finish. The diverse mix of disruptive spells, efficient removal, and graveyard synergy allows for adaptability to various matchups and strategies.

The deck focuses on ramping into powerful Eldrazi creatures while utilizing control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It aims to accelerate mana production through cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talismans, allowing for early plays of massive threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. Control elements like Kozilek's Return and Karn, the Great Creator help deal with opposing threats while Malevolent Rumble and Nulldrifter provide card advantage. Sowing Mycospawn serves as a versatile removal and token generator, making it difficult for opponents to stabilize. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with large threats while controlling the game tempo.

This deck aims to win by using a combination of creature abilities and instant/sorcery spells to deal damage to the opponent without needing to play any lands. By utilizing cards that allow for free or discounted spells, as well as countering the opponent's spells, the deck aims to quickly build up damage through various creature abilities and eventually finish off the opponent with cards like Goblin Charbelcher. It focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while maintaining a strong offense through efficient card synergy.

The main objective of this deck is to use various mill cards to quickly deplete your opponent's library, while also controlling the game with removal spells and counterspells. By consistently milling cards from your opponent's library and utilizing cards like Archive Trap and Field of Ruin to disrupt their strategy, you can quickly outpace your opponent and win the game through decking them out. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Surgical Extraction and Fatal Push allow you to interact with your opponent's cards and disrupt their game plan further.
